locationPermission.title: Location access needed
locationPermission.description: Charted needs your location to show you on the map and function as a real hiking application - be able to track your hikes.

notificationPermission.title: Enable notifications
notificationPermission.description: Allow notifications so Charted can remind you if you forgot to stop tracking your hike.

backgroundLocation.title: Background location needed
backgroundLocation.description: To track your hike while using other apps or with the screen locked, select "Allow all the time" on the next screen.

locationDenied.title: Location for tracking required
locationDenied.description: To start tracking a hike, Charted needs access to your location. Enable it in Settings to continue.

cannotLeaveApp.title: Background tracking disabled
cannotLeaveApp.description: Without background location access your hike won't be recorded if you switch apps or lock your screen. Enable it, or track only while the app is open.
